siteTagline: 人和 AI 智能体共享的代码库语义
homeTitle: Ontology Atlas: codebase ontology for coding agents (MCP)

descriptions.home: AI 智能体改动代码时，也能持续理解你的系统。共享任务上下文，查看已记录的语义和依据，并在本地 Markdown 文件夹中决定保留什么。
descriptions.download: 下载 Ontology Atlas，与智能体共享代码库上下文，并查看已记录的语义、依据和未知项。macOS 应用已签名，Windows 测试版未签名，没有 Atlas 后端。
descriptions.topology: 把项目的领域、能力、要素及其依赖画成一张地图。每个文件顶部的信息块就是地图，文件保留在你自己的磁盘上。
descriptions.docs: 直接阅读和编辑 Markdown 文件夹。改动文件顶部的信息块，地图随之更新。
descriptions.projects: 这张地图上的所有项目和枢纽，以及各自包含的领域和能力。
descriptions.ontologyInsights: 按类型统计的概念数量、连线最多的枢纽，以及仍未连到任何东西的概念。扩充地图前先看这里。
descriptions.guide: 从 Markdown 文件夹开始，连接你的编码智能体，学习如何在 Ontology Atlas 中查看已记录的语义、依据和未知项。
descriptions.changelog: Ontology Atlas 更新日志：用户可见的变更，最新的在前。
descriptions.library: Gather sources, compile them into wiki pages, and ask questions that cite their passages, all inside your local Markdown folder.
descriptions.agents: See the coding agents on this computer and connect them to Ontology Atlas over MCP.
descriptions.automations: Schedule ontology reviews and document checks that run on your computer and leave proposals for you to review.
descriptions.git: Review your folder's Git history, read each change as a document, and restore a single file.

guideDescriptions.firstFiveMinutes: Watch Ontology Atlas move before you install: the first screen is a read-only sample map that shows what a Markdown folder turns into.
guideDescriptions.readingTheMap: Read the Ontology Atlas map: what each dot and line means, why sizes and counts differ, and how a click focuses a concept and its neighbours.
guideDescriptions.vaultStructure: Your ontology is a plain Markdown folder. Learn the fields in the info block at the top of each file that turn it into a graph.
guideDescriptions.whatBecomesANode: Decide what becomes a concept: when something is a domain, a capability or an element, and why one file is not one concept.
guideDescriptions.relations: How relations between concepts work in Ontology Atlas: one line in the info block at the top of a Markdown file, not a row in a database.
guideDescriptions.studio: Edit concepts and relations right beside the selected concept on the map, without writing YAML by hand.
guideDescriptions.fromYourRepo: Start an ontology from what you already have: your code, its folder structure, and CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, extracted with your coding agent.
guideDescriptions.connectAgent: Connect a coding agent to Ontology Atlas over MCP in one click: Atlas writes the tool's configuration with the real absolute path.
guideDescriptions.growingVault: Keep a growing folder healthy: find duplicates, see what a rename breaks, and know what to fix when people and agents add concepts every day.
guideDescriptions.insights: The Insights screen answers what to fix next: concept counts by kind, the most-connected hubs, and concepts attached to nothing.
guideDescriptions.cli: The Ontology Atlas CLI is the daily entry point from a source checkout: check, snapshot and inspect a folder from the terminal.
guideDescriptions.trust: What Ontology Atlas does not do: no backend, account or telemetry, and your files stay on your disk.
